content:
Odd-hour moves lie on one axis: lengths \(2,4,6,8\).  
Even-hour moves lie on the perpendicular axis: lengths \(3,5,7\).

To maximize distance, take all odd moves in the same direction and all even moves in the same perpendicular direction:

\[
\text{component 1} = 2+4+6+8 = 20
\]
\[
\text{component 2} = 3+5+7 = 15
\]

\[
\text{distance} = \sqrt{20^2+15^2} = \sqrt{400+225} = \sqrt{625} = 25
\]

\boxed{25}
